raw_comment:
1) What do you notice? 
I notice that most of the hot weather states are abnormally dry. Some of the cold states are always abnormally dry. I noticed that a good percentage of the country is under drought. I noticed that the area of Texas that is extremely dry is the one near Mexico. 

2) What do you wonder?
I wonder if this drought has something to do with how the climate is rapidly changing. How come the places that are near the ocean and have access to rivers and lakes have some sorta level of drought? I wonder if at some point the northeastern side of the country will no longer have the 4 seasons and will the western side of the country will have the 4 seasons?

3) How does this relate to you and your community?
This relates to me and my community because it means that the summer and winter will be extremely cold or extremely hot. It will increase the amount of fires that happen every year. It will dry out our lakes and rivers.

4) What’s going on in this graph?
“Escalating Droughts: U.S. Faces Severe Water Shortages”
